title: Product Manager, Payments Platform
description:
Kestrel builds payment infrastructure used by roughly 4,000 small and mid-sized businesses across North America. The Payments Platform group owns the core money-movement services other teams build on: authorization, settlement, ledgering, disputes, and payouts.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own the payouts area end to end — the systems that get money out of Kestrel and into a merchant's bank account, on schedule, correctly, every time.

What you'll do:
• Own the payouts roadmap: what we build, in what order, and what we decline to build
• Talk to merchants and internal support weekly; turn recurring pain into a prioritized problem list
• Write product requirement documents and clear acceptance criteria; partner daily with engineering and design through delivery
• Define and watch the metrics that say whether payouts are healthy — settlement latency, failed-payout rate, support contact rate per thousand payouts
• Run discovery on new payout rails and write the business case for or against
• Work with Risk, Compliance, and Treasury on anything touching money movement, KYC obligations, or reserve policy
• Present roadmap and tradeoffs to leadership monthly; say no to good ideas with reasons

What you'll bring:
• 3–6 years in product management, ideally in payments, fintech, or another regulated domain
• Comfort with ambiguity and with saying no; strong written communication is the core skill here
• Fluency reading data yourself — SQL, Amplitude or similar; you should not need an analyst to answer a basic question
• Experience writing PRDs, running discovery interviews, and maintaining a groomed backlog in Jira
• Understanding of ACH, card networks, or real-time payment rails is a strong plus
• Track record shipping with engineering teams working in two-week sprints
• You will not have direct authority over engineers; influence and clarity are how the job gets done

Salary range $135,000–$175,000 plus equity. Hybrid, three days a week in our Austin office.
